To assemble the chair, place the seat upside down on a soft surface and attach the four legs by aligning them with the corner holes and tightening the screws lightly using the provided Allen key. Next, position the backrest at the rear of the seat, align the holes, and insert and tighten the remaining screws securely. Once all parts are connected, check that the chair is level, fully tighten all screws, and turn the chair upright. Assemble the chair on a flat surface and avoid overtightening the screws.

To disassemble the chair, place it upside down on a soft and flat surface, then use the Allen key to loosen and remove all screws securing the backrest to the seat before carefully separating the backrest. Next, remove the screws attaching each leg to the seat and detach the legs one by one. Keep all screws and small parts together to avoid loss during storage or transport, and store the chair components in a dry and safe place to prevent damage.

At the end of the chair’s service life, disassemble all components and separate the materials such as metal, plastic, wood, and fabric where applicable. Dispose of each material according to local recycling and waste management regulations. Reusable parts should be recovered whenever possible, and damaged or non-recyclable components must be disposed of through an authorized waste collection facility. Do not dispose of the chair in natural environments or with uncontrolled household waste.
